items.title: Potion Shop bug quest (NEW)
items.hint: On your first visit to Castle Town as a child, step into the potion shop. A bug has escaped — the shopkeeper hands you a bottle to catch it with. Trap the critter against a wall or the pots, catch it, and bring it back. He lets you keep the bottle, filled with a red potion.
items.remakeNote: Brand-new in the Switch 2 remake — the original game only had four bottles.

items.title: Super Cucco game
items.hint: Wake Talon up at Hyrule Castle, then head to Lon Lon Ranch and play the Super Cucco mini-game. Find the three special cuccos among the flock to win a bottle of Lon Lon Milk — the bottle is yours to keep.

items.title: Cucco Lady's lost flock
items.hint: The Cucco Lady in Kakariko has lost seven cuccos around the village. Round them all up and toss them back into her pen, then talk to her for the bottle.

items.title: Ruto's letter
items.hint: Win the Silver Scale in Zora's Domain, then slip through the underwater shortcut into Lake Hylia. A bottle holding Princess Ruto's letter is at the bottom — deliver it to King Zora and keep the empty bottle.

items.title: Poe Collector's reward
items.hint: As an adult with Epona and the Fairy Bow, ride Hyrule Field and leap over the glowing purple markers on horseback to wake the Big Poes. Two arrows each brings one down — bottle its soul and sell five to the Poe Collector in the Ghost Shop at the Castle Town gate for 500 points. He rewards you with the final bottle.
items.remakeNote: The remake only asks for 5 Big Poes (500 points). The original wanted all 10.
